aboutPreview.label: Who we are
aboutPreview.desc1: Founded in 2015 in Dakar, AfricTivistes is a pan-African civil society organization that brings together bloggers, cyber-activists and change agents across 45 African countries.
aboutPreview.desc2: Our mission: to use digital tools and new technologies to strengthen democracy, promote good governance and foster sustainable development across the continent.
aboutPreview.pillar1Desc: Building the capacities of change agents through online and in-person training.
aboutPreview.pillar2Desc: Creating pan-African networks of bloggers, activists and engaged citizens.
aboutPreview.pillar3Desc: Developing platforms and technological tools in service of democracy.
aboutPreview.pillar4Desc: Engaging communities in citizen monitoring and accountability.

history.title: Our History
history.subtitle: Since 2015, AfricTivistes has been building active digital citizenship in Africa. A look back at the key moments of our journey.
history.originTitle1: From a bold idea to a
history.originDesc1: AfricTivistes was born in 2015 in Dakar, Senegal, from the desire of African bloggers and cyber-activists to organize themselves to promote democracy and good governance through digital tools. What started as an informal network has become a structured pan-African organization, present in 45 countries across the continent.
history.originDesc2: Driven by the conviction that digital technology is a powerful lever for social transformation, the organization quickly brought together change agents committed to a more transparent, inclusive and democratic Africa.
history.visionDesc: With 10 years of experience and a network of over 400 members in 45 countries, AfricTivistes continues its mission with a renewed vision: making digital technology a tool for citizen empowerment, democratic transparency and sustainable development for the African continent.
history.ctaDesc: Join the AfricTivistes organization and help write the next chapter of digital citizenship in Africa.
values.title: Our Values
values.subtitle: The core principles that guide each of our actions and shape our vision of a digital, democratic and inclusive Africa.
values.introDesc1: At AfricTivistes, our values are not mere words. They are the foundation of each of our initiatives, the guiding thread of our programs and the compass of our commitments. They reflect our pan-African identity and our determination to use digital technology as a tool for citizen empowerment.
values.introDesc2: Each value carries a promise: that of contributing to building African societies where every citizen has the means to actively participate in democratic life.
values.civic.title: Civic engagement
values.civic.desc: Mobilizing citizens for active participation in democratic life. We believe every voice matters and that digital technology can amplify citizen expression across the entire continent.
values.solidarity.title: Pan-African solidarity
values.solidarity.desc: Uniting the continent's forces to defend digital rights and strengthen cooperation among change agents. Our network transcends borders to create a powerful collective movement.
values.inclusion.title: Digital inclusion
values.inclusion.desc: Ensuring access and participation for all in digital tools, regardless of gender, language or geographic location. The digital space must be one of equality and opportunity for every African.
values.transparency.title: Transparency
values.transparency.desc: Promoting open governance and institutional accountability. We demand from public authorities what we impose on ourselves: total transparency in management and decision-making.
values.innovation.title: Responsible innovation
values.innovation.desc: Developing endogenous technological solutions that address African realities. Innovation only makes sense when it serves communities and the common good.
values.resilience.title: Informational resilience
values.resilience.desc: Strengthening the capacity of citizens and media to resist disinformation and manipulation. A healthy information space is the foundation of any living democracy.
values.principlesTitle: How our values translate into action
values.principle1Desc: AfricTivistes is an organization independent of any political party, government or private interest. This independence guarantees the credibility and impartiality of our actions.
values.principle2Desc: Each program is designed with clear indicators and measurable objectives. We report on our results with rigor and honesty.
values.principle3Desc: Our solutions are co-created with local communities. We respect the cultural and political contexts of each country of intervention.
values.principle4Desc: We work in partnership with civil society organizations, academic institutions, media and technology stakeholders across the continent.
values.quoteText: Digital technology is the most powerful lever of social transformation Africa has ever known. Our responsibility is to put it at the service of every citizen.
values.ctaDesc: Join a community of over 400 change agents working every day for a digital, democratic and inclusive Africa.
join.title: Become an AfricTivist
join.subtitle: Join a dynamic community of engaged citizens working for positive change in Africa.
join.communityDesc1: AfricTivistes is much more than an organization, it is a dynamic community of engaged citizens working for positive change in Africa. If you share our passion for democracy, citizen participation, good governance, technological innovation and the defense of human rights, then you are in the right place.
join.reason1Desc: As a member of AfricTivistes, you will be at the heart of the action for a better African continent. Your voice and your commitment matter.
join.reason2Desc: Access our online training platform, explore our educational resources and develop your skills in active citizenship.
join.reason3Desc: Connect with other engaged citizens, activists, journalists and social change professionals across Africa.
join.reason4Desc: Contribute to our projects and initiatives, from fighting fake news to promoting cybersecurity and beyond.
join.reason5Desc: See your actions translate into concrete impact on democracy, human rights and development in Africa.
join.step1Desc: Fill out our membership form below with your information and motivations.
join.step2Desc: Your application will be carefully reviewed by our team, including your profile and activities.
join.step3Desc: Once your membership is approved, you will be notified by email.
join.step4Desc: Get actively involved in our projects, share your ideas and contribute to the transformation of Africa.

initiatives.planTitle: Impact and technological innovation for democracy in Africa
initiatives.planDesc1: A pan-African network at the intersection of technology and democracy since its creation in 2015, AfricTivistes mobilizes change agents and partners who share our vision of an Africa where civic tech serves as a lever for participatory democracy.
initiatives.planDesc2: Through its areas of intervention, the pan-African network intensifies its efforts to promote democracy, human rights and governance in Africa through technological innovation and citizen engagement.
